segments.text:
V. 18.
Rachel weeping for her children—The Benjamites, who inhabited Rama, ſprung from her. She was buried 〈◊〉 this Place; and is here beautifully repreſented, riſen, as it 〈◊〉 out of her Grave, and bewailing her loſt Children. Becauſe they are not—that is, are dead. The Preſervation of Jeſus from this Deſtruction, may be conſidered as a Figure of GOD'S Care over his Children in their greateſt Danger. GOD does not often, as He caſily could, cut off their Perſecutors at a Stroke: But He provides a Hiding-place for his People, and by Methods not leſs effectual, tho' leſs pompous, preſerves them from being ſwept away, even when the Enemy comes in like a Flood.
